versions.content: The function Fr_GetAbsoluteTimerIRQStatus shall perform the following tasks: 1. Check whether the interrupt of absolute timer Fr_AbsTimerIdx is pending. Write TRUE to output parameter Fr_IRQStatusPtr in case the interrupt is pending, FALSE otherwise. 2. Return E_OK.
